pulse.author: PULSE
pulse.description: Watch a video together: /watch play <link> in a text channel posts a card anyone can watch from, or plays for a voice room — a YouTube video (through its own embedded player), a direct media file or an HLS stream, with shared play, pause and seek. Other video sites are not resolved.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm
